description: `job update` of a schedule: the 405 keeps the service message and names `cli job configure`.

body.error: Schedule settings must be changed with unified execution settings.

problem.action: Correct the request as details.reason and details.serviceMessage describe, then retry.

details.reason: `cli job update` changes webhook jobs only; change a schedule job with `cli job configure 7b2e4d19-6a3c-4e85-b1f0-9c4d8e2a6b73 --interval-seconds N --yes` or `cli job configure 7b2e4d19-6a3c-4e85-b1f0-9c4d8e2a6b73 --config-file FILE --yes`, and see details.serviceMessage for other job types
details.serviceMessage: Schedule settings must be changed with unified execution settings.

problem.message: The OpenProse service rejected the request.
